meta.title: San Clemente Market, April 2026: Median 11 Days on Market, 100.8% Sale-to-List | Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's
meta.headline: March closed strong. Here's what that tells us about April.
meta.lede: March was the cleanest month San Clemente has seen in over a year. Median time on market fell to 11 days, homes closed above list, and price cuts sat among the lowest in Orange County. This issue also looks at Capistrano Beach and Beach Road.
meta.description: San Clemente single-family homes sold in a median 11 days in March 2026, down from 19 a year earlier, at a 100.8% sale-to-list ratio and a $1.81M median price. Plus Beach Road, the tightest direct-sand pocket in Capistrano Beach. By Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty.
